description:
These clay brick tiles for kitchen walls are thin natural clay tiles with a brick face, used to give kitchens a rustic, exposed-brick look on walls and backsplash areas.

## How they look
The tiles keep the natural colour of fired clay, so the wall has the warm, slightly varied tone of real brick. Laid in a running bond, they suit both traditional Pakistani kitchens and modern open kitchens that want some texture.

## Where they work
- **Kitchen walls and the area above counters**, away from direct flame.
- **Breakfast corners and dining nooks**.
- **Restaurant and café kitchens open to the dining area**, where the brick wall is on show.

If you want a lighter tone, compare with the [handmade yellow gutka tiles](/products/handmade-natural-yellow-gutka-brick-kitchen-wall-tiles).

## Good to know
Natural clay is porous. In a kitchen, a breathable clear sealer is usually applied after fixing so oil and turmeric stains wipe off more easily, and reapplied every so often. Behind the stove itself, many people use a glazed tile strip and keep the brick for the rest of the wall.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), check the colour against your cabinets, and get a dated quote for your wall area. More options are in the [kitchen wall terracotta range](/categories/kitchen-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of clay brick tiles for a kitchen wall?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Do clay brick tiles need sealing in a kitchen?
faqs.a: Usually yes. Natural clay is porous, so a breathable clear sealer helps oil and spice stains wipe off. Reapply it from time to time on the busiest areas.

faqs.q: Clay brick tiles or ceramic brick-look tiles?
faqs.a: Clay brick tiles are real fired clay with natural colour variation; ceramic brick-look tiles are printed or glazed and are easier to wipe but look more uniform. Clay gives the more authentic texture.

faqs.q: How do I order a sample?
faqs.a: Send the product name and your city on WhatsApp to +92 300 4617715, or visit the Lahore or Islamabad showroom.
